svg.title: X-linked inheritance in Morgan's eye-color cross
svg.desc: Original schematic, not to scale. Red and blue chromosomes retain the source parental ancestry. P female red X(w+)/red X(w+) and white-eyed male blue X(w)/blue Y produce red-eyed F1 daughters and sons. Their gametes form four illustrated F2 classes: w+/w+ female, w+/Y male, w/w+ female and w/Y white-eyed male. A hooked Y carries no w allele.
